title: Endorsement Risk Premium Returned on Cancellation — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Treatment on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) of the risk premium charges booked by the policy's latest premium-bearing endorsement (a coverage increase or deductible decrease) when the policy is cancelled.

**Rule.** The endorsement risk premium a cancellation returns is settled as follows: when the cancellation effective date falls on or after the current term start and the claim bar applies, nothing is returned; when the policy's latest premium-bearing endorsement took effect after the cancellation effective date, its risk premium charges are returned in full; when it took effect on or before the cancellation effective date within the term the cancellation takes effect in, they are returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the end of that term over the days from the endorsement's effective date to the end of that term; otherwise they are returned with the term premium they belong to.

**The claim bar here** applies when the reason is one of mortgage paid off, voluntary — not required, replaced by private flood, and removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area by a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision, and a loss dated on or after the current term start carries claim payments, net of the payment items voided, above zero, or the current term's return is held because the records cannot place such a paid loss on either side of the current term start, that is when no loss dated after the month band around the current term start carries such payments, a loss dated in that band does, and the latest loss on which a claim payment was ever issued is dated after the band, or is dated in the band on or after the current term start with its payments all voided; the month band is the losses dated as many whole calendar months before the processing date as the current term start is.

**Returned with the term premium they belong to** means: for the days from the cancellation effective date to the end of their term over the days of the current term when their term is the one the cancellation takes effect in, in full when their term began after the cancellation effective date, and not at all when their term ended before it.

## Ladder

1. Effective on or after the current term start and the claim bar applies → nothing.
2. Endorsement took effect after the cancellation effective date → its risk premium charges in full.
3. Endorsement took effect on or before the cancellation effective date, in the same term → days from the cancellation effective date to the end of that term, over the days from the endorsement's effective date to the end of that term.
4. Otherwise → with the term premium they belong to.

## Case (hypothetical)

Endorsement risk premium 400.00, endorsement effective with 200 days of the term left, cancellation effective with 50 days left, no claim bar: 400.00 times 50 over 200 is 100.00.
